messages:
sam (support): Hey team, client reported a bunch of requests being routed to EU instead of US. They say their SDK sends a region param but it's ignored. cc @amelia :eyes:
client-ops: Hi — we're seeing higher latency for requests that should hit us-east. Example request we sent: `GET /v1/generate?region[]=us-east&region[]=eu-west` with header `x-client-region: us-east`. Response came from eu-west edge.
sam (support): Thanks. Can you paste the raw request/response headers and a request_id from a failing call?
client-ops: request_id=cl-2026-03-15-8891, raw headers: `x-client-region: us-east`, `accept: application/json`. We generate query from client code and it ends up as `region[]` array param — we didn't expect that.
amelia (engineer): That array-style query param rings a bell. Our router's query parsing picks the last value when it sees repeated keys, and for arrays it was picking index 0 in the parsed list due to parser behavior. If region[]=us-east&region[]=eu-west it ends up choosing eu-west in our current logic.
stefan (infra): Interesting — which parser lib? Could be a breaking change from the SDK or our gateway.
amelia (engineer): Looks like the gateway uses qs v6 for parsing. The client's SDK v1.12.3 started serializing region as `region[]` after a refactor; previously it sent `region=us-east`.
sam (support): So client change -> router misinterprets -> misroute. Can we short-term fallback to header precedence? Client has header set correctly.
amelia (engineer): Yes we can. Quick mitigation: change routing precedence so `x-client-region` header wins over query params. That's a low-risk config patch. I'll open a canary rollout to the edge fleet.
stefan (infra): I'll coordinate. Amelia, please include the route-id and approval for a 5% canary first. Also add a log flag to emit which field decided the region for each request.
amelia (engineer): Will do. Patch: `router: prefer_header_region: true` and `log.region_decision=true`. Pushing to staging now.
deploy-bot: Deploy started — build rtr-2026.03.15-9 -> staging -> canary groups enabled
amelia (engineer): Staging looks good, logs show header wins and region_decision=header for test requests. No regressions in token routing.
sam (support): Client confirmed: after we flipped header-precedence, their failing request started routing to us-east. Client is happy for now but wants a permanent fix.
client-ops: Thanks — can you also add a note in docs about the SDK serializing region as array? We spent a few hours debugging.
amelia (engineer): Yep — follow-up: we'll patch the SDK to stop serializing single-valued region as an array, and we'll add docs recommending `x-client-region` header as canonical. I'll create a PR and link it here.
sam (support): Great. Leaving this thread open until SDK PR and a config rollback (if desired) are done. Closing action items: canary->100% after 24h, SDK patch PR, docs update. :white_check_mark:
